description: Renovate preset for the statewalker monorepos: extend it with "github>statewalker/.github".

schedule: before 7am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Third-party updates inside the current ranges: one weekly pull request, merged when CI passes.
Our own packages: as soon as they are published, one pull request for all of them, so each release moves up through the dependent repositories.
GitHub Actions: grouped and merged when CI passes.
Toolchain versions (pnpm, Node) move by hand, across all repositories at once.
